newsitem.title: USA: Dollar General sees second half rebound.
newsitem.headline: Dollar General sees second half rebound.

text.p: Dollar General Corp Chairman and Chief Executive Cal Turner said Tuesday he expect "sales to rebound in the second half."
Turner said that during the first half, "we are hurting sales increases by dropping an advertising circular and by re-merchandising every store."
He added, however, "We are happy with our management of expenses in this environment."
Dollar General reported same-store sales for the first quarter ended May 2 increased 3.8 percent from a year earlier, and total sales increased 14.1 percent to $520.0 million from $455.9 million.
The company said it opened 141 new stores and closed 15 during the quarter.
Dollar General is a chain of more than 2,860 neighborhood stores operating in 24 states.
